answer: Operator liability escrow ties each agent identity to an accountable operator via shared control evidence. A reused payout account or signed quartz token links identities; after an attack, the system fines that operator $10 per linked identity and freezes payouts until paid, not the wallets. A prism audit traces split control evidence back to the same operator. That operator cost makes a fable of cheap identities fail: each sybil adds real liability.
